title: Camping: Action Stills
heading: Camping music video: new action shots for Bob and Tarquin
moodboard_intro: ROUND 2, from your notes: Bob bleak (no smiles; cold, wet, moved on), Tarquin in real action (peak-of-movement set pieces showing greed and contempt). Clean room again: fresh web research, three sealed writers (bleak Bob; Tarquin action; Tarquin action seen through the damage he does). Your 12 round-1 picks are kept and shown as Picked at the top of each section. Flags: b23 shows a readable supermarket sign; b21 (wringing out a hosed-down sleeping bag) never came back from Flow. Tap This on the ones to animate.
